title: Speaking — Finding affordable activities
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on finding affordable activities.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
What things do you do for enjoyment at little cost?
Do you look for discounts before planning outings?

part2.topic: Describe an inexpensive activity that was more enjoyable than you expected.
part2.closing: and explain why you would choose it again.

questions: What should local governments do to keep leisure affordable?
How can high prices affect which young people join organised activities?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to finding affordable activities?
